text: Stripe checkout for buying a painting
description: Stripe Checkout session per painting incl. chosen shipping option; webhook marks the painting as sold.

status.comment: Built + deployed (server/routes/shop.ts, REST, no SDK); paused by user. Webhook signature verified locally (bad sig 400, completed → sold). Needs STRIPE_SECRET_KEY + STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and a webhook endpoint in Stripe.
